user.title: Tuya WebGroups
user.description:
Paste the browser cookie from the Tuya Smart web app (cn.device.tuyasmart.com). This is a **session ticket** and has to be refreshed when it expires.

How to get it: sign in at https://cn.device.tuyasmart.com → F12 → Network → any request → copy the full Cookie header.

Leave Home ID empty to pick a home in the next step.

home.title: Choose a home
home.description: This account owns several homes; pick the one whose light groups you want to sync.

error.invalid_auth: Cookie invalid or expired: sign in again and copy a fresh cookie
error.no_groups: No light groups in this home: create one in the Tuya App first

init.title: Tuya WebGroups options
init.description: Refresh the cookie here once it expires. Leave group IDs empty to sync every light group of the home.
